item.title: Man shot at Clearwater apartments accused of threatening couple, striking 70-year-old
item.description: A man who was shot at a Clearwater apartment complex on Saturday was arrested on charges of aggravated assault, according to the Clearwater Police Department.

item.title: LIST: Shelters open in Tampa Bay as cold front moves in
